```{r setup}
library(brdstns)
```
## Stations database example 
```{r , echo=FALSE}

mystns=system.file("extdata/stations.csv", package = "brdstns")
mystat<-stns_db(stnf=mystns)
knitr::kable(mystat)

```

## Stations directory structure

```{r , echo=FALSE}
myparms<-stns_plst_set("Cedar","puc",2026,9)
mystns=system.file("extdata/stations.csv", package = "brdbrain")
stns_new(myparms,stnf=mystns)
fs::dir_tree("Aviary")
```
